reason: Neither component window shows an absorption dip at its predicted position: around 3935.7 Å the flux stays at continuum (~0.5-1.2) with no K-like trough, and around 3970.5 Å the flux is likewise continuum-level (~0.2-1.0) with no H-like trough. The claimed centers (3942.8, 3988.4) are offset by 7-18 Å and show no coherent pair; the measured separation (45.6 Å) far exceeds the expected 34.8 Å, and the K/H depth ordering is inverted. The two-component interpretation is not corroborated.
